addProductsToWishlist.description: The `addProductsToWishlist` function allows you to add products to a user's wishlist. This function is typically used when a user wants to save a product for later purchase.
addProductsToWishlist.events: Emits the `wishlist/data` event with the updated wishlist information after adding the products. This event may be emitted multiple times depending on the operation flow (e.g., creating a new wishlist, merging wishlists, or updating an existing wishlist).

items.description: An array of wishlist items to add, each containing product information such as SKU, quantity, and selected options.

getStoreConfig.description: The `getStoreConfig` function retrieves the store configuration, which includes various settings and preferences for the store.

getWishlistById.description: The `getWishlistById` function retrieves a wishlist by its ID. This is useful for accessing a specific user's wishlist.
getWishlistById.events: Emits the `wishlist/data` event with the retrieved wishlist information.

wishlistId.description: The unique identifier of the wishlist to retrieve.

getWishlists.description: The `getWishlists` function retrieves all wishlists associated with a user. This is useful for displaying all wishlists a user has created.

mergeWishlists.description: The `mergeWishlists` function allows you to merge a wishlist from local storage with one belonging to a registered user. This is useful when a user wants to synchronize both local and remote wishlists into one wishlist after logging in.

removeProductsFromWishlist.description: The `removeProductsFromWishlist` function allows you to remove products from a user's wishlist.
removeProductsFromWishlist.events: Emits the `wishlist/data` event with the updated wishlist information after removing the products. This event may be emitted multiple times depending on whether the wishlist becomes empty after removal.

items.description: An array of wishlist item identifiers to remove from the wishlist.

updateProductsInWishlist.description: The `updateProductsInWishlist` function allows you to update the quantity of products in a user's wishlist.

wishlistItemId.description: The unique identifier of the wishlist item to update.

quantity.description: The new quantity for the wishlist item.

description.description: Optional description or note for the wishlist item.
